newsitem.title: UK: PowerGen rises on share buyback move.
newsitem.headline: PowerGen rises on share buyback move.

text.p: Shares in British electricity generator PowerGen Plc gained 7 1/2p to 579p on Thursday after the company announced a buyback of up to five percent of its capital.
PowerGen said it had instructed UBS Limited and Kleinwort Benson Securities Limited as agent to purchase for cancellation 33.5 million shares.
"We wouldn't be buying strongly at this level -- our advice would be to hold. The shares appear to be fairly fully valued,' said one analyst, who declined to be named.

PowerGen said last month that it would buy back up to 10 percent of its shares. The plan came amid market speculation about the company's strategy after its 1.95 billion stg bid for Midlands Electricity Plc was blocked by regulators earlier this year.
